text: Over the last 30 days, some visitors have raised concerns about overcrowding, especially when large school groups visit simultaneously, which limits access to exhibits. Several critical reviews focused on the heavy use of AI in the exhibits, with some feeling it detracts from the educational value and does not adequately convey Theodore Roosevelt’s historical significance. A few visitors noted the lack of an introductory film and desired more detailed information about Roosevelt’s accomplishments. Other common topics included appreciation for the interactive exhibits and architecture, though some mentioned issues with parking and accessibility. Overall, while the average rating remains high, attention to exhibit content balance and visitor flow could improve the experience.
